units.locator: Article 11.1. Acts endangering traffic safety on railways and the metro
units.text: Note. A person who commits an administrative offence provided for in part 5 or 5.1 of this Article consisting in crossing railway tracks at an unauthorized place shall be held administratively liable if, within one kilometre of the place where the crossing occurred, there was a pedestrian crossing, tunnel, bridge or other place specially equipped or designated for crossing and marked with an information sign.

units.locator: Article 11.3. Acts endangering flight safety
units.text: 1. Placement in the vicinity of an aerodrome, heliport or landing site of signs and devices resembling the marking signs and devices used to identify aerodromes, heliports or landing sites —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 11.3

units.locator: Article 11.3. Acts endangering flight safety
units.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand to two thousand rubles; on officials, four thousand to five thousand rubles; and on legal entities, ten thousand to twenty thousand rubles.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 11.3 · “shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on…”

units.locator: Article 11.3. Acts endangering flight safety
units.text: 2. Use of pyrotechnic articles on the territory of an airport, aerodrome, heliport or landing site or in an approach zone to an aerodrome, heliport or landing site without permission from the administration of the airport, aerodrome, heliport or landing site —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 11.3

units.locator: Article 11.3. Acts endangering flight safety
units.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand to two thousand rubles with confiscation of the instrument used to commit the administrative offence; on officials, four thousand to five thousand rubles with confiscation of the instrument used to commit the administrative offence; and on legal entities, ten thousand to twenty thousand rubles with confiscation of the instrument used to commit the administrative offence.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 11.3 · “shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on…”

units.locator: Article 11.3. Acts endangering flight safety
units.text: 3. Damage to the equipment of an aerodrome, heliport or landing site, to aerodrome signs or to an aircraft —
units.label: Part 3 Art. 11.3

units.locator: Article 11.3. Acts endangering flight safety
units.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand to two thousand five hundred rubles.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 11.3 · “shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one…”

units.locator: Article 11.3. Acts endangering flight safety
units.text: 4. Walking or driving without permission on the territory of an airport (except the passenger terminal) or aerodrome or a facility providing radio or lighting support for flights —
units.label: Part 4 Art. 11.3

units.locator: Article 11.3. Acts endangering flight safety
units.text: shall entail a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine of five hundred to one thousand rubles.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 11.3 · “shall entail a warning or the imposition of an administrative…”

units.locator: Article 11.3. Acts endangering flight safety
units.text: 5. Violation of the procedure for organizing the movement of special-purpose vehicles and mechanization equipment at an aerodrome —
units.label: Part 5 Art. 11.3

units.locator: Article 11.3. Acts endangering flight safety
units.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand rubles.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 11.3 · “shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one…”

units.locator: Article 11.3. Acts endangering flight safety
units.text: 6. Failure to comply with rules for placing daytime and nighttime marking signs and devices on buildings, structures, communication lines, power transmission lines, radio equipment or other facilities for the purpose of ensuring aircraft flight safety —
units.label: Part 6 Art. 11.3

units.locator: Article 11.3. Acts endangering flight safety
units.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand to two thousand rubles; on officials, four thousand to five thousand rubles; and on legal entities, ten thousand to twenty thousand rubles.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 11.3 · “shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on…”

units.locator: Article 11.3.1. Violation of aviation security requirements
units.text: 1. Failure to comply with or violation of aviation security standards, rules or procedures, except in the cases provided for in parts 2 - 4 of this Article —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 11.3.1

units.locator: Article 11.3.1. Violation of aviation security requirements
units.text: 2. Failure to take measures to maintain the fences of a controlled territory or restricted-access zone or the ground structures of an airport, aerodrome or heliport —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 11.3.1

units.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of two thousand to four thousand rubles; and on legal entities, four thousand to ten thousand rubles.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 11.3.1 · “shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on…”

units.locator: Article 11.3.1. Violation of aviation security requirements
units.text: 3. Failure to take measures to prevent persons, hand luggage or baggage, cargo, mail or aircraft supplies that have not undergone screening, or objects or substances prohibited from carriage by aircraft, from being brought on board an aircraft —
units.label: Part 3 Art. 11.3.1

units.locator: Article 11.3.1. Violation of aviation security requirements
units.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of two thousand to three thousand rubles; and on legal entities, ten thousand to fifty thousand rubles.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 11.3.1 · “shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on…”

units.locator: Article 11.3.1. Violation of aviation security requirements
units.text: 4. Bringing or assisting in bringing on board an aircraft persons, hand luggage or baggage, cargo, mail or aircraft supplies that have not undergone screening, or objects or substances prohibited from carriage by aircraft —
units.label: Part 4 Art. 11.3.1

units.locator: Article 11.3.1. Violation of aviation security requirements
units.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand to three thousand rubles; and on officials, ten thousand to thirty thousand rubles.

units.locator: Article 11.4. Violation of airspace use rules
units.text: 1. Violation by an airspace user of federal airspace use rules, where this act does not constitute a criminal offence —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 11.4

units.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of twenty thousand to fifty thousand rubles; on officials, one hundred thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, two hundred and fifty thousand to three hundred thousand rubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 11.4 · “shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on…”

units.locator: Article 11.4. Violation of airspace use rules
units.text: 2. Violation of airspace use rules by persons who have not been granted, in the prescribed manner, the right to engage in activities involving the use of airspace, where this act does not constitute a criminal offence —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 11.4

units.locator: Article 11.4. Violation of airspace use rules
units.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of thirty thousand to fifty thousand rubles; on officials, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand rubles; and on legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand rubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 11.4 · “shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on…”

units.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules
units.text: 1. Violation of the procedure for authorizing aircraft to fly or of rules for flight preparation and performance, except in the cases provided for in parts 3 - 9 of this Article, where these acts negligently cause minor harm to the victim's health —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 11.5

units.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules
units.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand five hundred to two thousand rubles or deprivation of the right to operate an aircraft for three to six months; on officials, three thousand to four thousand rubles; and on legal entities, fifty thousand to eighty thousand rubles.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 11.5 · “shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on…”

units.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules
units.text: 2. The same acts negligently causing harm of moderate severity to the victim's health —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 11.5

units.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules
units.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to two thousand five hundred rubles or deprivation of the right to operate an aircraft for up to one year; on officials, ten thousand to twenty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, eighty thousand to one hundred thousand rubles.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 11.5 · “shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on…”

units.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules
units.text: 3. Taking off in an aircraft with defects that prohibit commencement of a flight without permission from an authorized body, or in violation of passenger (cargo) capacity standards or aircraft flight weight or centre-of-gravity limits —
units.label: Part 3 Art. 11.5

units.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules
units.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the pilot-in-command of two thousand to two thousand five hundred rubles or deprivation of the right to operate an aircraft for up to one year.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 11.5 · “shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the…”

units.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules
units.text: 4. Operation of an aircraft by a person who does not have the right to operate it —
units.label: Part 4 Art. 11.5

units.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules
units.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of two thousand to two thousand five hundred rubles.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 11.5 · “shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of two…”

units.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules
units.text: 5. Operation of an aircraft that has not undergone state registration or has not been entered in state records, or does not bear nationality and registration marks or a record identification mark, or bears knowingly false nationality and registration marks or a knowingly false record identification mark —
units.label: Part 5 Art. 11.5

units.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules
units.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the pilot-in-command of two thousand to two thousand five hundred rubles or deprivation of the right to operate an aircraft for up to one year.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 11.5 · “shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the…”

units.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules
units.text: 6. Operation of an aircraft without the aircraft and flight documentation required by the legislation of the Russian Federation on board, or operation of an aircraft by a flight crew member who does not carry documents authorizing the operation of that type of aircraft —
units.label: Part 6 Art. 11.5

units.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules
units.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand to two thousand rubles.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 11.5 · “shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one…”

units.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules
units.text: 7. Operation of an aircraft by an intoxicated person, or evasion by the person operating an aircraft of a medical examination for intoxication in accordance with the established procedure, or transfer of control of an aircraft to an intoxicated person —
units.label: Part 7 Art. 11.5

units.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules
units.text: shall entail deprivation of the right to operate an aircraft for two to three years.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 11.5 · “shall entail deprivation of the right to operate an aircraft…”

units.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules
units.text: 8. Authorizing a flight by an aircraft that has not undergone state registration, or has not been entered in state records, or does not bear nationality and registration marks or a record identification mark, or bears knowingly false nationality and registration marks or a knowingly false record identification mark, or does not have on board the aircraft and flight documentation required by the legislation of the Russian Federation, or does not have a full flight or cabin crew, or has defects that prohibit its operation without permission issued by an authorized body, or violates passenger (cargo) capacity standards or aircraft flight weight or centre-of-gravity limits, as well as allowing a person who does not have the right to do so or is intoxicated to operate or service an aircraft, or servicing an aircraft by a person who does not have the right to do so or is intoxicated —
units.label: Part 8 Art. 11.5

units.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules
units.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand rubles; and on officials, ten thousand to fifteen thousand rubles.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 11.5 · “shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on…”

units.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules
units.text: 9. Conducting flights by aircraft that do not have on board the search and emergency rescue equipment required by the legislation of the Russian Federation —
units.label: Part 9 Art. 11.5

units.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules
units.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand five hundred to two thousand rubles; on officials, three thousand to four thousand rubles; and on legal entities, thirty thousand to forty thousand rubles.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 11.5 · “shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on…”

units.locator: Article 11.5.1. Violation of requirements for placing information on the terms of an air carriage contract in an automated information system for issuing air transport documents or of requirements for an automated information system for issuing air transport documents
